title: WPSS/1716/2021 of ASHWANI SRIVASTAVA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
ON THE 04TH DAY OF JANUARY, 2022
BEFORE:
HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1716 of 2021
BETWEEN:
Ashwani Srivastava ...Petitioner
(By Mr. Abhijay Negi, Advocate)
AND:
State of Uttarakhand and others ...Respondents
(By Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State)
JUDGMENT
Petitioner was appointed as Tabla
Sangatkar in M.K.P. (P.G.) College, Dehradun,
which is a Government Aided College.
2. According to the petitioner, he was paid
salary from public ex-chequer, as he was
appointed against a sanctioned post. Now,
petitioner has retired in the Month of January,
2021. Since petitioner has not been paid any
amount as gratuity, pension, therefore, petitioner
has approached this Court.
3. Learned Additional Chief Standing
Counsel for the State has pointed out that
Director, Higher Education has issued a letter on
22.10.2021 to the Principal of the concerned
College to fix petitioner's pay-scale at the
appropriate level. He further submits that since
Principal of the College has not responded to the

2
said letter, therefore, Director, Higher Education is
unable to process claim of the petitioner.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner,
however, submits that Principal of the College has
fixed petitioner's pay-scale at the appropriate level
and sent the same to Director, Higher Education
vide letter dated 30.07.2021, therefore, the
objection raised by the Director, is without any
substance.
5. After arguing for a while, learned
counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner
be permitted to make a representation to Director,
Higher Education, who may be called upon to take
decision thereupon within some stipulated time
frame.
6. Learned Additional Chief Standing
Counsel for the State has no objection, if the
prayer made by the petitioner is granted.
7. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed
of with liberty to petitioner to make fresh
representation to Director, Higher Education,
within 10 days from today. If petitioner makes
such representation for release of gratuity,
pension and also interim pension within the
stipulated time frame, Director, Higher Education
shall look into the matter and take appropriate
decision, as per law, within 8 weeks thereafter.
